theorem: For every integer n>=0, the predeclared Enterprise area readout of T_n equals 3n.
proof: For each declared triangle side s in {OU,OV,UV}, the side-local incidence labels are (s,r) with 1<=r<=n.
The three side labels make the incidence families disjoint as typed incidence objects, regardless of shared corner vertices.
Each family has exactly n unit adjacency incidences by the integer parameter r.
Therefore the disjoint union has n+n+n incidences.
Equivalently A_0=0 and layer n contributes exactly (OU,n),(OV,n),(UV,n), so A_n=A_(n-1)+3.
finite_enumeration_role: verification only; theorem follows from the recurrence certificate
